title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – price basis 2027, counterproposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer. Applying your own stated cost weights to the index changes gives about 7.5% on our current 5.45 EUR/kg, roughly 5.86 EUR/kg, not 6.05 EUR/kg.

Your letter doc:20260706-70710-M1 states that your nickel and alloy requirement is covered at fixed prices until March 2027. Scorecard sc:70710@2026Q3 shows 75 ppm and 88% OTD, below your 50 ppm commitment. Your owner offered to walk us through the calculation (doc:20260421-70710-M2).

Could you share that material and conversion breakdown and arrange an authorized pricing review? We propose a 24-month agreement without an index clause; please see the attached packages.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – price basis 2027, counterproposal
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We appreciate your detailed review. While we can support a 24-month agreement, we must include an AS-14404 index clause for contracts of this duration to manage long-term volatility. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our colleagues will address your request for a cost breakdown and pricing review separately.

Our main proposal stands at a price of €5.52 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: a price of €5.64 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 - 24/36-month agreement with AS-14404 deadband
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for the revised offer. We can accept an AS-14404 clause if it carries a deadband and the base price reflects it.

Our category estimate part:370010 puts AS-14404 at a 0.43 weight of cost, below the 45% you state. Your hedge until March 2027 also shields you from early index moves, which supports a 5% deadband.

We can offer a 36-month commitment, which gives you secured volume beyond our usual term. Please see the attached packages.

We would appreciate the authorized pricing review your colleagues mentioned. Could you also tell us whether a cheaper variant, for example different bar lengths or tolerances, is possible?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 - 24/36-month agreement with AS-14404 deadband
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We can present our main offer at a price of €5.57 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This Angebot is valid for 30 days. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €5.54 per unit, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Our technical department will reach out to you separately to discuss potential cost savings through different bar lengths or tolerances, as well as the pricing review. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 – deadband, payment terms and 36-month option
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for the revised offer and the variant savings, which our engineering team will review.

AS-14404 moved from 2839.71 (idx:AS-14404@2025-09) to 3007.80 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a computed change of 5.92%. At your 45% material share that is about 2.7% on price, so a 5% deadband is reasonable.

Our forecast fc:370010@2026-09 records a 1.9% change, which points to stable and growing call-offs under a longer agreement.

We therefore propose the attached packages, including a 36-month commitment. Could you confirm the earliest date for the authorized pricing review your colleagues mentioned?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – deadband, payment terms and 36-month option
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for the ongoing exchanges. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We have reviewed your forecast data; while the volume increase is modest, we value the stability of a 36-month commitment. 

We can therefore accept the 90-day payment terms and offer a revised price of €5.56 per unit. For complete clarity, our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Our current commercial terms are a price of €5.56 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our sales management will reach out next week to coordinate the pricing review. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. Our Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Logistics: We are well loaded. Our Lieferzeit is 10 days, and with overtime we can deliver in 10 days, at a premium.
